# Jure Sanguinis Guide

> A guide to claiming Italian citizenship by descent, with eligibility basics, resources, community highlights, and monthly news.

This site provides practical, community-informed guidance for Jure Sanguinis applicants. Use the pages below for overviews, curated resources, and updates.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://rjuresanguinis.com/): High-level overview and entry points
- [About Jure Sanguinis](https://rjuresanguinis.com/about-js): Eligibility and process basics
- [Resources](https://rjuresanguinis.com/resources): Curated tools and guides
- [FAQ](https://rjuresanguinis.com/faq): Common questions and answers
- [Community](https://rjuresanguinis.com/community): Reddit highlights and discussions
- [News](https://rjuresanguinis.com/news): Monthly news briefings
- [Tracker](https://rjuresanguinis.com/tracker): Application tracker status
